## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and the problem it solves.

## Verification

List the exact commands and desktop/platform checks run. State any proof that
was not run.

## Visual evidence

Add before/after screenshots for UI changes, or write "Not applicable."

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and excludes unrelated cleanup.
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior or the reason they do not is explained.
- [ ] No credentials, provider tokens, private transcripts, project data, or generated build output are included.
- [ ] Public documentation is updated when behavior, prerequisites, permissions, adapter support, or release artifacts changed.
